## Objective
The repository contains a single runnable Java class that prints a greeting to standard output.

## Interface
File `src/Main.java`: `public class Main` with `public static void main(String[] args)` in the default package.

## Behavior
1. Running `Main` prints exactly `Hello, World!` followed by a newline to standard output.
2. The program exits with status 0.

## Invariants
Uses only the standard library; no build tool files are added.

## Edge cases
None.

## Guardrails
Do not create other files. Do not add packages, tests or build configuration.

## Out of scope
Build tooling (Maven/Gradle), tests, command-line arguments.
